Layer 0 verdict 'cuda_identical_host_differs' and Layer 2's 112 rounds of bitwise-identical results confirm this. No input value can distinguish between two identical compiled kernels.

rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing tools should filter out comment-only mutations during mutant generation, as they always produce equivalent mutants. This can be done by parsing the AST and ignoring string literals within comment tokens before applying const_perturb operators.
